title: Berkshire Hathaway 2026 Annual Meeting: Part 3 5/3/26

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Greg Abel and leaders answer questions about Berkshire's future and current business topics.
reader_summary.overview: The final episode of the 2026 Berkshire Hathaway Annual Meeting features CEO Greg Abel joining two other leaders for a Q&A session. They discuss the future of Berkshire subsidiaries and the current inflation environment. CNBC hosts then recap the busy day with highlights from both sessions and an interview with Warren Buffett.

key_points.text: Leaders address questions about the future of Berkshire subsidiaries and the current inflation environment.
key_points.evidence_quote: Together, the three address questions about the future of Berkshire's subsidiaries, the current inflation environment, and much more.

notes: In the third and final episode from the Berkshire Hathaway Annual Meeting in Omaha, CEO Greg Abel takes the second Q&A session alongside BNSF Railway CEO Katie Farmer and Adam Johnson, CEO of NetJets and President of Berkshire’s consumer products, services, and retailing businesses. Together, the three address questions about the future of Berkshire’s subsidiaries, the current inflation environment, and much more. And finally, CNBC’s Becky Quick and Mike Santoli recap the busy day with highlights from both Q&A sessions and Becky’s interview with Warren Buffett. For more Berkshire Hathaway coverage: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/02/warren-buffett-berkshire-hathaway-annual-meeting-2026-live-updates.html For past Berkshire Hathaway annual shareholder meetings: https://buffett.cnbc.com/annual-meetings/ Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company. Together, the three address questions about the future of Berkshire’s subsidiaries, the current inflation environment, and much more. And finally, CNBC’s Becky Quick and Mike Santoli recap the busy day with highlights from both Q&A sessions and Becky’s interview with Warren Buffett.
